annotations.title: Score an uploaded or pasted FRQ

description: Scores a student's existing FRQ even when it did not come from Fiveable. If the student attached photos, the host AI must first transcribe the prompt and response, show the transcription for confirmation, then call this tool. Optional prompt images preserve graphs or artwork that text alone cannot represent. Fiveable scores it on the AP rubric for its exact question type, out of that type's AP point total. Requires sign-in; one scoring preview is included without a plan, with further scoring available to eligible accounts. The attempt is saved to the student's Fiveable progress. Returns a pending scoring job; poll get_scoring_result. Reuse requestId for retries.

frqType.description: The exact AP question type as Fiveable names it, e.g. "Document-Based Question (DBQ)". If it doesn't match, the tool lists this subject's types.

intent.description: Privacy-safe reason for the request. Use explain, quiz, notes, frq, or research; never send the student's raw prompt for analytics.

promptImages.description: Optional original prompt images for diagrams, graphs, maps, or artwork.

data.description: Base64 image payload without a data-URI prefix.

promptLabel.description: Short label shown in attempt history.

promptText.description: Verified transcription or pasted text of the complete prompt.

requestId.description: Stable unique request ID. Reuse it only for retries of the same submission; a new response needs a new ID.

responseImages.description: Optional response images that must be evaluated visually, such as a student-drawn graph.

data.description: Base64 image payload without a data-URI prefix.

transcriptionConfirmed.description: Must be true only after the student confirms the transcribed prompt and response text.

name: score_external_frq_response

status.description: Operation status: completed, pending, partial, failed, unavailable, or a domain-specific outcome.

text.description: Readable tool result text for clients that consume structured output.
